reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

source_record.bounded_interface_domain: The receiving decision actually uses the named causal prediction, discriminating observation or tested correction at its bounded scope. The named object, configuration, relevant time/population and actual receiving use are identified. Similar language, possible encoding, organizational co-use or an arbitrary tool does not establish a bridge. Unknown applicability remains unknown. A supported partial premise can be material while the whole receiving predicate remains unestablished.
source_record.domain_horizon_authority: The exact member object, configuration, observation interval, consequence and actual authority in each literal argument; no adoption or legal applicability inference.
source_record.evidence_ceiling: No singular-root guarantee, universal improvement, field causal effect or template efficacy follows. Intervention observations need their actual causal contrast. Analytical native-role inference only; no empirical effect size, universal benefit, new historical descent or final scientific acceptance.
source_record.common_cost_and_alternative: Investigation, safe experiments, alternative explanations, side effects, follow-up ownership and ability to act count. A trivial one-off reversible issue can receive a cheap fix and recorded observation; escalate when the actual uncertainty or recurrence warrants it.

positive_controls.argument: Competing hypotheses and an explicit prediction identify a discriminating verification method and the outcome that would defeat the countermeasure claim.
The causal account and side-effect predictions identify which component and integration observations are distinct and necessary to assess the proposed change.
Competing explanations and outcome predictions distinguish a real intended-use improvement from a process metric improvement, informing representative validation.
The causal model and disconfirming cases identify conditions in which the correction is predicted to work or fail, guiding bounded qualification of the changed article.
A tested countermeasure with retained alternatives and adverse results supplies bounded repair evidence for the actual delivery and exposes unresolved residuals.
A provenance-bearing problem definition, prediction and tested response can supply the corrective-action evidence the actual basis requires at its defined scope.
Explicit hypotheses, predictions, contrary results and alternatives give a challenger a concrete causal claim to test rather than a single polished root-cause story.
A safely testable causal prediction can discriminate whether a proposed control changes the identified hazard mechanism and can reveal harmful side effects.
Qualified countermeasure evidence supplies one causal premise with alternatives, conditions and defeaters, rather than treating corrective activity as proof.
A predicted intervention effect, safe trial and recurrence observation supply bounded readiness evidence and identify what rollback or monitoring must test.
Predictions, follow-up ownership and recurrence/side-effect criteria identify what ongoing assurance must observe to retain or withdraw the countermeasure claim.
Competing alternatives, predicted side effects and bounded test results inform the real risk decision and may warrant no change rather than a favored intervention.

source_record.independent_review_scope: Required later fidelity and adversarial reviews must examine common premises, exact member bridges, all contrary controls and separately authored reverse arguments. This author validation supplies no reviewer acceptance.
source_record.common_source_dependence: Shared observations, policies, assets, actors or original sources are not multiple independent controls or benefits; common-mode failure and cost remain.

The valid outcome may be no change. A3/Five Whys/PDSA labels have no evidential force; S047 does not show reported fidelity causes success.

source_record.inference: At P1-P4 the literal member contribution is a material input to its receiving assessment. A no-change decision may remain justified. This rule cannot be extended by title, similarity, generic use, sampling, symmetric reversal or complete-target screening.
